mapper.sql: id, code, name, agent_code, prompt_type, scene_code, status, active_version_id, description, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: select from prompt_template where prompt_type = #{promptType} order by status asc, update_time desc, id desc
mapper.insert: insert into prompt_template(code, name, agent_code, prompt_type, scene_code, status, description) values(#{code}, #{name}, #{agentCode}, #{promptType}, #{sceneCode}, #{status}, #{description})
mapper.update: update prompt_template set name = #{name}, agent_code = #{agentCode}, prompt_type = #{promptType}, scene_code = #{sceneCode}, description = #{description} where id = #{id}
update prompt_template set status = #{status} where id = #{id}
update prompt_template set active_version_id = #{activeVersionId} where id = #{id}
